mnist.name: mnist
mnist.normalization: none; raw pixels are stored and normalized by the experiment code

source.license: CC BY-SA 3.0, as stated in the Keras dataset documentation
source.index_order: Original x_train/y_train and x_test/y_test arrays in mnist.npz

mnist.split_policy: For each class, RNG(seed) shuffles official train indices: first 500 train, next 100 validation; RNG(seed+1) selects first 100 shuffled official test indices. Each selected split is then shuffled.
